html: † תַּתְּנַי n.pr.m. Pers. prefect in Syria;—Ezr 5:3, 6; 6:6, 13; Θανθανας, Τανθαναι, A Θαθθαναι; 𝔊L Τανθαναιος, Σισιννης; Σισιννης also 3 Esdr 6:3; 7:26 JosAnt. xi, 12, 89, etc. (Lag Psalt. Hieron 162 n.; AS § 1335 n.; MeyEntst. J. 32 assumes *OP *Thithnaya, or Thathnaia); but Uštanni, Uštanu, was prefect in Syria under Darius, according to contr. tablets, v. Strassm Darius 27, 82; names prob. identical; MeissnZAW xvii (1897), 191 f. reads therefore ושׁתני (וַשְׁתָּנִי Hpt), cf. Buhl Gu Ezr-Neh. 63; Scheft94; however, thinks תתני = תסני = OP thāsna, Av. sāsna (teaching), and this transp. in NBab. Uštanu.
